title: May Brooke

authorInfo.bio: Anna Hanson Dorsey (1815–1896) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "May Brooke" by Anna Hanson Dorsey is a novel written in the late 19th century. The book follows the life of May Brooke, a kind-hearted and resilient young woman navigating her new life under the guardianship of her stern Uncle Stillinghast, while also dealing with her recently arrived cousin, Helen, who faces her own struggles.
